message.text:
**Calculating inbound call counts**

I need to calculate the count of inbound calls for internal declarations. I'll likely need some utility functions for that. Searching for function declarations and their calls across the codebase could be really tedious. Using a shell script with `awk` seems like a good option since I can't use Python. I'll gather the function names and count their occurrences in the files. It looks like `internal/webhook.PostAsync` might have the highest number, with `internal/profile.NewProfile` potentially having even more callers. I can generate the declarations using regex and process them with `awk`.

args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; for f in internal/**/*.go internal/*.go; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; awk '/^func (\([^)]*\) )?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\(/ {print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0}' "$f"; done

shopt -s globstar nullglob; : > /tmp/internal_funcs; for f in internal/**/*.go internal/*.go; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; awk '/^func /{x=$0; sub(/^func /,"",x); sub(/^\([^)]*\) /,"",x); sub(/\(.*/,"",x); print x "\t" FILENAME ":" FNR}' "$f"; done | sort -u > /tmp/internal_funcs; while IFS=$'\t' read -r n loc; do c=0; for f in **/*.go; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; x=$(awk -v n="$n" 'index($0,n "(") {c++} END{print c+0}' "$f"); c=$((c+x)); done; echo -e "$c\t$n\t$loc"; done < /tmp/internal_funcs | sort -rn | awk 'NR<=30{print}'

**Counting candidates efficiently**

I need to count the candidates, and it looks like using AppendConditions might be the way to go. My plan is to implement one awk command per candidate to keep things fast. I think that’ll streamline the process quite a bit. I should be careful to ensure that I’m able to track everything accurately while making sure the execution remains efficient. Let's get this sorted out!

args.command: for n in AppendConditions GetHTMLMeta GetImage RenderMarkdown RenderHTML ExtractAll ExtractProperties ExtractTags HasPrefixes ValidateContent GetCurrentVersion ConvertStringToInt32 NewMentionParser NewTagParser GetJobName PostAsync ValidateURL isReservedIP safeDialContext secureDialContext ResolveAlias; do c=0; for f in **/*.go; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; x=$(awk -v n="$n" 'index($0,n "("){c++} END{print c+0}' "$f"); c=$((c+x)); done; printf '%4d %s\n' "$c" "$n"; done | sort -rn
